name: fallback_denominator_audit_v1
purpose: Determine whether the published 1B/4B exact-refit fallback fractions divide the fallback count by the number of attempted decrements or by the larger count of enumerated head-boundary cells.

audited_claim.text: The reverse path uses exact refit after failed post-verification in 396/1,024 1B and 2,020/4,320 4B head-gates.

denominator_semantics.n_head_gates: len(layer_ids) * len(gated) * n_heads; every enumerated layer/boundary/head cell, including boundaries that precede every deleted position and therefore never attempt a decrement
denominator_semantics.n_solves: incremented only when forgotten_here is non-empty; the number of head-boundary cells where a decrement was actually attempted
denominator_semantics.n_fallback: incremented only inside the forgotten_here branch, on RuntimeError from the incremental decrement; therefore drawn from the n_solves population

finding: The published pair mixes populations: the numerator is drawn from attempted decrements (n_solves) while the denominator is the enumerated cell count (n_head_gates). 384 of the 1,024 1B cells and 1,280 of the 4,320 4B cells never attempted a decrement. The fallback rate is therefore understated.

internal_inconsistency.description: The nu-sweep diagnostic reports fallback against the attempted-decrement denominator while the cohort claim reports against the enumerated one, for the same 4B record.
internal_inconsistency.diagnostic_source: gemma_sv/diagnose_fallback_density.py lines 104-111, which names n_solves 'affected_head_decrements' and divides by it
internal_inconsistency.diagnostic_record: whole_record_confirm_v2.json index 0 (tofu-final-320-a), which the cohort report gives as n_solves=400, n_head_gates=560
internal_inconsistency.consequence: Appendix claims the nu=0.7 diagnostic rate of 236/400 (59%) explains the direction of the all-record rate. Against the published 39%/47% the diagnostic overshoots the cohort; against the corrected 61.9%/66.4% it agrees closely.

remediation.code: gemma_sv/summarize_boundary_evidence.py _certificate now divides by affected_head_decrements and emits enumerated_head_gates separately; schema bumped to gemma-sv-mass-preserving-boundary-evidence-v3
remediation.unaffected_claims: The 248/1,920 expanded-audit figure is already attempt-denominated (248 fallbacks + 1,672 completed decrements = 1,920) and the legacy 276/320 and 260/272 figures already say 'affected head-gates'.

affects_exactness_note: The fallback is the refit-without-target, so certified KL and every exactness claim are unchanged. Only the disclosed frequency of the incremental path changes.
